content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Important Dates
IIT Delhi Project Scientist Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 3 vacancies across three distinct post designations.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates of Indian nationality are invited to appear for the walk-in test / interview.

rows.qualification_required: Master's degree (M.S./M.Sc.) in any Biological Sciences discipline including Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or related fields. Desirable Qualification and Experience: Knowledge of Precision Medicine and related research methodologies. Experience in software development for biological or healthcare applications. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, Java, or similar experience with bioinformatics tools, data analysis.

Master's degree (M.Tech/M.Des) in any field of engineering/Design discipline including industrial design, UI/UX design, interaction design, HMI design, BTech/BE in engineering in computer science, Mechanical engineering electronics engineering, communications engineering, electrical engineering, etc. Desirable Qualification and Experience: Knowledge of user-centric design, design and innovation, usability in design, storytelling, UI flows, and creative thinking. Knowledge about medical devices.

B.Tech IT SKILLS* Full-Stack & Mobile: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js (MERN Stack), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Python, Native Android REST APIs* Software & Vision: OpenCV, OpenSlide, RGB Color Analysis, Interactive UI Flows* Database & Tools: MongoDB, SQL, Git, Docker. EXPERIENCE* Full-Stack Developer | Built GUI and backend control software for hardware developer.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Walk-in Test and Interview. Candidates who fulfill the above qualifications/experience should appear for the interview. Eligible candidates must bring a formal application on Form No. IRD/REC-4, which can be downloaded from the IRD Website, along with complete information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks of each examination passed, details of work experience, and a recent passport size photograph, along with original certificates (both academic & professional) for verification on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Project Scientist
content_sections.text: Visit the official IRD Website to download Form No. IRD/REC-4. Fill out the form completely with information regarding educational qualifications, marks, work experience, and attach a recent passport-size photograph. Gather all original academic and professional certificates for verification. If already employed in the Institute / IRD, ensure your application is duly forwarded by the concerned establishment/section. Attend the walk-in test and interview on 21 October 2026 at 10:00 A.M. onwards at Room No. 121 A (II C Building (Academic Complex East, IIT Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi - 110016). For clarification on eligibility, candidates may contact the principal investigator at email: [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Formal application on Form No. IRD/REC-4 Original educational certificates (academic & professional) Original work experience certificates Recent passport-size photograph No Objection Certificate (if already employed in the Institute / IRD, duly forwarded by the concerned establishment/section)

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on a contractual basis on consolidated pay renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates who are already employed in the Institute / IRD shall be interviewed unless their application has been duly forwarded by their concerned establishment/sections. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. Unscheduled caste / Unscheduled tribe candidates who belong to the SC/ST category will be given a 5% relaxation of marks in accordance with the institutional guidelines. Any clarification required on eligibility can be obtained by contacting the principal investigator at email: [email protected]
